heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 112–141, div. A, title I, § 1119(b), July 6, 2012, 126 Stat. 491]

notes.text: Section, added Pub. L. 87–866, § 6(b), Oct. 23, 1962, 76 Stat. 1147; amended Pub. L. 97–424, title I, § 126(d), Jan. 6, 1983, 96 Stat. 2115, related to public lands development roads and trails.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Oct. 1, 2012, see section 3(a) of Pub. L. 112–141, set out as an Effective and Termination Dates of 2012 Amendment note under section 101 of this title.
